132-198-3263-4687.easyPrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
132-198-3263-4687.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding one mana for each charge counter on it.
Activate Myr Welder using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, targeting any permanent.
Repeat.

4-1170-1636-7490.description:
Cast Rejoinder using Hoarding Broodlord's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Elite Interceptor.
When Elite Interceptor enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

2146-3532-5078-7742.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
2146-3532-5078-7742.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Machinesmith Automaton triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Machinesmith Automaton.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4762-5902-7741.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Shang-Chi and Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

4217-6709-7302.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
4217-6709-7302.description:
Cast Whirlwind Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Ballad of the Black Flag.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Whirlwind Technique targeting Lutri.
Resolve Whirlwind Technique, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Ballad of the Black Flag.
Repeat from step 3.

1409-4231-5444.description:
Activate Carnage Interpreter by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Carnage Interpreter enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Carnage Interpreter trigger, causing you to discard your hand, and then create four Clue, four Food and four Treasure tokens due to Academy Manufactor.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Carnage Interpreter.
Activate two Treasure by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

236-539-560-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Animating Faerie // Bring to Life.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

339-677-3967-6965.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4377-4423-6701-6886.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
4377-4423-6701-6886.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Walk the Aeons from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons during your draw step.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-4052-6264.notablePrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
392-4052-6264.description:
Activate Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty by discarding a card.
Cryptcaller Chariot triggers, causing you to create a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Kindred Discovery triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty ability.
Repeat.

654-3688-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
654-3688-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
654-3688-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Everywhere.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zhur-Taa Ancient triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

1365-1379-4853-5256--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-1379-4853-5256--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

3921-5115-5149.notablePrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Gemstone Array.
3921-5115-5149.description:
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {1}, putting two charge counters on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

57-2178-5004-5231.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Feldon of the Third Path.
Feldon of the Third Path does not have summoning sickness.
57-2178-5004-5231.description:
Activate Feldon of the Third Path by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Cathodion with haste.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Cathodion token, adding {R}.
When the Cathodion token dies, it and Feldon of the Third Path trigger.
Resolve the Feldon of the Third Path trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1335-1887-2034.notablePrerequisites: Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1335-1887-2034.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on Marath.
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Elemental, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1679-2351.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card during an opponent's turn.
1679-2351.description:
Draw a card during an opponent's turn.
The Watcher triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters the battlefield, Dire Undercurrents' first ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

152-1872-4772.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating two token copies of Composite Golem with haste.
Activate both Composite Golem tokens by sacrificing them, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

423-511-3510-4868.notablePrerequisites: Sporoloth Ancient has at least three spore counters on it.
423-511-3510-4868.description:
Activate Sporoloth Ancient by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield as a Forest land due to Life and Limb, Evolution Sage triggers, putting two spore counters on Sporoloth Ancient.
Repeat.

1887-2060-3490-3517-4868.notablePrerequisites:
Crystalline Crawler has at least one +1/+1 counter.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
1887-2060-3490-3517-4868.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield, triggering Tainted Observer, causing you to pay {2} to put four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Animation Module triggers four times.
Resolve the first three Animation Module triggers, choosing not to pay.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Resolve the final Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

1750-2793-3743-5261.notablePrerequisites: Osgir does not have summoning sickness.
1750-2793-3743-5261.description:
Activate Osgir by tapping it, paying {5}, and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating two token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put one of them into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token copy of Ugin's Nexus that was just put into your graveyard triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Osgir by paying {1} and sacrificing a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
The sacrificed token copy of Ugin's Nexus triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Osgir's ability resolves, giving target creature you control +2/+0 until end of turn.
Move to your next extra turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by tapping it and paying {2}, copying Pull from Eternity.
Cast Pull from Eternity, returning Ugin's Nexus to your graveyard.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat.

687-1085-2034.notablePrerequisites:
3 counters on Chronozoa or other permanents.
3 mana value or less creature in graveyard or top of library.
687-1085-2034.description:
Activate Tayam for {3} and removing 3 counters from Chronozoa.
Sacrifice Chronozoa to its Vanish trigger.
Create two token copies of Chronozoa due to its death trigger.
Return a 3 mana value or less creature to the battlefield.
Sacrifice a Chronozoa token and the other creature to ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2026-3147-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Voyaging Satyr does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Voyaging Satyr.
2026-3147-3525.description:
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{U}.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Azorius Chancery.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Repeat any number of times.
